summary.ja: 物理時間の硬球衝突と実際の分子輸送を計算し、独立SPARTAの資格確認済みモーメント場と比較します。
summary.en: Evolve physical-time hard-sphere collisions and molecular streaming; compare actual moments with qualified independent SPARTA fields.

assumptions.ja: 1次元位置・3次元速度、単原子硬球。Mach2、区間[0,16]、RHの開境界reservoir。192セル、粒子重み1/192、dt=.01、burn20/sample20、12seed。
assumptions.en: {"kind":"shock","cells":192,"length":16,"weight":0.005208333333333333,"dt":0.01,"burn_in":20,"sample_time":20,"blocks":5,"bins":64,"sample_every":10,"hist_velocity":[-4,7]} Twelve independent seeds; primary fixed-weight mesh,particle-weight,and half-step companions each retain seed1.

algorithm.ja: セル内の非重複ランダム対へ、偶数・奇数粒子数を区別した物理時間のσg衝突確率を適用。エネルギーによる安全上界で事前にsubcycle数を定め、確率clipはしません。壁・流入はflux重み付き分布と実際の残り飛行時間を用います。 開境界のmacro粒子到着数は平均を保つfloor(平均)+Bernoulli(小数部)で分散を下げます。Poisson数揺らぎや熱揺らぎの再現は主張しません。 既存4seedを残して次の8連番seedを追加します。一様順列と安定整数sortは対選択法則を保ちますが、乱数消費と軌道のbit一致は主張しません。 2026-11-24版は固定reservoir係数、同一vで既評価の逆CDF残差、keep→left→right順の連結だけを再利用する性能修正版です。元の乱数呼出順・衝突対選択・科学設定を保ち、成分資格163項目でbit/RNG一致を確認しました。全計算の一致は今回のmain後に別途判定します。
algorithm.en: Disjoint cell-local random pairs with even/odd finite-N physical-time sigma*g acceptance,energy-based safe majorant and predeclared bounded subcycling; no probability caps. Exact flight-to-wall and flux-conditioned diffuse/reservoir velocities with remaining flight time. Open-reservoir macro counts use unbiased floor(mean)+Bernoulli(fraction) per face/species/half-stream to reduce artificial sampling variance; no Poisson number-fluctuation or thermodynamic-fluctuation reproduction claim. Retain the original four seeds and append the next eight consecutive seeds; uniform permutation/stable integer sorting preserves the ideal within-cell matching law,not RNG consumption or bit-identical trajectories. Edition2026-11-24 only reuses immutable reservoir coefficients and a previously checked inverse-CDF residual at unchanged v,and fuses concatenation in unchanged keep-left-right particle order. Component163checks establish exact byte/RNG equivalence; full-run equivalence is a separate pending postcheck. Collision matching,RNG calls and every scientific input remain unchanged.

validation.ja: 各群20pytestを事前固定。新しい固定計算は15本。境界込みの質量・運動量・エネルギー、局所λ/衝突時間、独立参照への誤差とseed精度、時間block定常性を別に判定します。 群の判定は既存81項目を保持し、新8計算の48項目を追加した129項目です。primary t95はdf11、独立参照4seedはdf3です。 Nov23保存成功と全15計算・129判定の厳密比較を行う新mainは、本契約の時点で未実行です。20pytestと全mainの外部共有上限120秒、全診断・NPZ・CSVを維持します。
validation.en: Predeclare20pytest per group and15new fixed primary runs. Separate boundary-inclusive budgets,local lambda/collision-time diagnostics,reference error,whole-seed precision and block stationarity. Reference36runs/87qualifiers already passed; primary results remain pending until the frozen run. Preserve all81old gates and add48new-run gates=129. Primary12seed t95 usesdf11,reference4seed usesdf3; descriptive approximate-normal whole-seed intervals,not unconditional adaptive-study coverage. This new edition main has not run at contract freeze. Retain all20pytest,15runs,129gates and the original shared120s outer deadline,then compare every saved scientific array/history/metric with the immutable successful Nov23baseline. No independent reference is regenerated.

limits.ja: 有限粒子・有限格子の独立確率参照との限定比較です。線形応答、連続体極限、全DSMC、VHS一般、空間次数を認証しません。RHは遠方状態・流束だけの参照で、内部構造の厳密解ではありません。図は保存した粒子位相空間であり、2D物理流れではありません。
limits.en: Finite-particle finite-grid independent stochastic reference,empirically qualified; no rigorous continuum bound,linear-response/general-DSMC/VHS or spatial-order claim. RH validates far states/full fluxes,not an exact internal shock profile. Saved phase space is not a2D physical flow.

formulas: P_{ij}=n\langle c_i c_j\rangle,\quad q_x=\frac{n}{2}\langle c_x|\mathbf c|^2\rangle,\quad\mathbf c=\mathbf v-\mathbf u
p_{ij}=a_N W\sigma g_{ij}\Delta t/V,\quad a_N=\begin{cases}N-1&N\text{ even}\\N&N\text{ odd}\end{cases}
